summary: 7 boxes (.123 host, plus .110 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) proven in one MotS session at the same time. Re-verified now through the host's netstat (two ESTABLISHED :2300 connections per joiner) and fresh SCREENSHOT 0 frames showing the in-level HUD on all 7. .124 BLOCKED (D3D on vcr-kmd); .186 and .243 NA. Game closed on all 7 boxes; PROCLIST shows no jkm.exe.
issues: Every box joined under the pilot 'fleet', not Fleet<octet>. On the Players screen the selected row is drawn WHITE; Fleet<octet> is preselected, so press RETURN without clicking.

lanparty check's SCREENSHOT 1 frames are all black for this 8-bpp title (black=True); SCREENSHOT 0 shows the level and HUD. lanparty has no roster or packet witness for peer titles; the host netstat is the witness.

jkm.exe ignored WM_CLOSE on all 7 boxes; lanparty kill force-closed it after 12 s. Afterwards every box was at its desktop mode (32 bpp, normal resolution) with the agent/chat console in the foreground and no crash dialog.
